code_prompt: clap_mangen (the man-page generator) does not render the per-value help text of an argument's PossibleValues in the generated man page — those help strings currently only appear in shell completions, not in `man`. Add rendering of each possible value's help to the man-page output for arguments that have possible values, using clap v4's CURRENT PossibleValue API (e.g. PossibleValue::get_name() and get_help()); do not hide values marked hidden. Follow the existing man-rendering conventions in clap_mangen/src/render.rs. Add or update a clap_mangen snapshot/golden test (clap_mangen/tests) that includes an argument whose possible values carry help text, so the test fails before your change and passes after. IMPORTANT: reconfirm the current v4 PossibleValue/Command API before coding; if rendering possible-value help is ALREADY implemented on current main, do not force a change — leave the tree unmodified and say so.
